{"text":"ItemID: unavailable; Title: Blue & Lonesome; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its blues focus fits my recent interest in Old Sock and Memphis; this would be my first choice.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Atmospheric instrumental rock is less appealing than the blues and song-driven music I want right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Soul City; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I cannot place this release from the title alone, so I would skip it on this visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Rhythm & Blues; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues direction appeals to me, but I would only explore a couple of albums this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Old Yellow Moon; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its roots-oriented songwriting could suit my interest in You Should Be So Lucky, but it is not my priority today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Nothin But Love; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues rock fits my recent listening, though I would save this for another visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Step Back; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Guitar-led blues connects with my interest in People, Hell & Angels and Old Sock; I would try this too.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Grrr: Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiar rock songs appeal, but I am more interested in exploring a studio album today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Ryan Adams; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The songwriting could fit my interest in You Should Be So Lucky, but I am leaning toward blues this visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Boys & Girls; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its soulful rock sound could appeal, but I would stop after my two stronger choices."}
